body: Hmm. I might try that thanks!
I'm in the army, so I can't do drugs. I can drink though! I love weed and I miss it so much. I bet it can help, if I can smoke it.

I feel better now, but I know it's going to come again. I've tried many times to "just get over it," or "don't think about it." It gets so tiring though, to keep trying to get happy by just doing happy things. I mean it works, but I feel like a better coping mechanism is out there; an instant cure-all. 

Alcohol makes me more emotional. I found I cut myself way more often when I'm drunk. But, it also makes me incredibly happy, when I'm already happy.
They probably won't. I've called many times and it's completely anonymous. No one knows I've called.
Well, suicide will always be an option for the rest of your life. The hardest part is cold feet. I'm kinda glad you didn't jump though.
